caption:
IN THE MATTER OF REQUEST FOR APPROVAL OF DELMARVA POWER & LIGHT COMPANY'S 2024-2025
STANDARD OFFER SERVICE RATES, PROCUREMENT COST ADJUSTMENT AND RARM FILING
title: DE PSC Docket 24-0365 — Order No. 10598
text:
BEFORE THE PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
OF THE STATE OF DELAWARE
PSC DOCKET NO. 24-0365
IN THE MATTER OF REQUEST FOR
APPROVAL DELMARVA POWER & 
LIGHT
COMPANY'S 2024-2025 STANDARD OFFER
SERVICE RATES, PROCUREMENT COST
ADJUSTMENT AND RARM FILING
(FILED MARCH 27, 2024)
ORDER NO. 10598
AND NOW, 
this 20"^ day of November 2024, the Delaware Public Service Commission
("Commission") determines and orders the following;
WHEREAS, 
on March 27, 2024, Delmarva Power & 
Light Company ("Delmarva") filed
revised electric tariffs reflecting revised Standard Offer Service ("SOS") rates, a revised
Procurement Cost Adjustment ("PCA"), and a revised Reasonable Allowance for Retail Margin
("RARM") with an effective date of June 1, 2024 (the "2024 SOS-PC A-RARM Filing");' and
WHEREAS, 
on May 1,2024, the Commission adopted Order No. 10439, which approved
the proposed tariff rates included in the 2024 SOS-PCA-RARM Filing on a temporary basis,
subject to refund; and
WHEREAS, 
pursuant to Order No. 10439, Delmarva published on May 14, 2024, in the
Delaware State News, The News Journal, and Cape Gazette, public notice of the 2024 SOS-PCA-
RARM Filing and the deadline of June 24, 2024 to file comments, objections or to file petitions to
intervene; and
' The 2024 SOS-PCA-RARM Filing includes information required pursuant to several Commission Orders, including
Order No. 6746 (Oct. 30, 2009), Order No. 7162 (Apr. 27, 2007), Order No. 8258 (Apr. 13, 2012), Order No. 8144
(May 15, 2012), Order No. 8093 (Dec. 20, 2011), and Order No. 8450 (Sept. 10, 2013), and Order No.9933 (Dec. 22,
2021)

PSC Docket No. 24-0365, Order No. 10598 Cont'd
WHEREAS, on July 29, 2024, the Delaware Division of the Public Advocate ("DPA")
filed its Statutory Notice of Intervention; otherwise, no petitions to intervene or objections or
comments were filed with respect to the 2024 SOS-PCA-RARM Filing; and
WHEREAS, after submitting its 2024 SOS-PCA-RARM Filing, Delmarva provided
-workpapers supporting the proposed electric tariff changes and bill impact information which
reflected a proposed monthly increase of $2.34^ (or an increase of 1.65%) for a residential
customer using 811 kWh per month on an annual average basis; and
WHEREAS, Delmarva also provided workpapers supporting the results of the RARM
factor on an actual basis for the RARM reporting year ending December 31, 2023, and determined
that the total RARM factor for fixed price customers decreased from $0.002126 to $0.001396 or
by 34.34%; therefore, a new RARM factor, as part of the Standard Offer Service rate, would be
effective Jrme 1, 2024; and
WHEREAS, Staff met with Delmarva in a workshop to review the 2024 SOS-PCA-
RARM Filing and related workpapers; and
WHEREAS, 
in late 2023 and early 2024, Delmarva conducted its nineteenth annual SOS
procurement for supply contracts commencing on June 1, 2024, using a Commission-approved
reverse auction process; and
WHEREAS, 
Staff published notice on October 21, 2024 on the Commission website of
an evidentiary hearing to be held on November 20, 2024; and
WHEREAS, 
the Commission held the noticed evidentiary hearing on November 20,2024,
at which Staff and Delmarva presented witnesses who testified that the 2024 SOS-PCA-RARM
Filing, all related workpapers, and proposed rates and tariff changes comply with previous
^This does not include the RPS Charge or the Qualified Fuel Cell Provider Renewable Charge ("QFCP-RC") or any
changes in distribution rates.

PSC Docket No. 24-0365, Order No. 10598 Cont'd
Commission orders, comport with the bidding results reflected in Liberty Consulting Group's
Technical Consultant's Final Report to the Commission titled "Technical Consultant's Final
Report to the Delaware Public Service Commission- Delmarva Power and Light's 2024 Request
for Proposals for Full Requirements Wholesale Electric Supply for Standard Offer Service" dated
February 21, 2024, and reflect the total supply costs for which Delmarva requested recovery; and
WHEREAS, Staff submitted a Memorandum to the Commission, dated November 13,
2024, which is incorporated herein by reference, wherein Staff recommends final approval of
Delmarva's proposed tariff revisions as set forth in the 2024 SOS-PCA-RARM Filing for the
period June 1, 2024 through May 31, 2025;
NOW, 
THEREFORE, 
IT IS HEREBY ORDERED BY THE AFFIRMATIVE
VOTE OF NOT FEWER THAN THREE COMMISSIONERS:
1. 
The proposed rates and tariff changes included in the 2024 SOS-PCA-RARM
Filing with an effective date of June 1, 2024, for the period ending May 31, 2025, are approved as
final.
2. 
The Commission reserves jurisdiction and authority to enter such further Orders in
this matter as may be necessary or proper.
BY ORDER OF THE COMMISSION:
/s/Dallas Wimlaw
Dallas Winslow, Chairman
Voted via Teleconference pursuant to
29 Del. C. § 10006(A)(d)
